title: Upgraded Tacloban airport eyes soft opening by March next year
summary: TACLOBAN CITY – The upgraded Daniel Z. Romualdez (DZR) Airport here could begin partial operations in March next year, provided that power supply requirements are completed and newly installed…

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – The upgraded Daniel Z. Romualdez (DZR) Airport here could begin partial operations in March next year, provided that power supply requirements are completed and newly installed equipment passes operational testing, a public works official said. Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Eastern Visayas Assistant Regional Director Ma. Margarita Junia said the March 2027 target is the earliest possible date for the airport’s soft opening, but stressed that the schedule remains tentative.
